changelog:
Initial release of Shortform Hook Writer.

- Generate natural, high-retention hooks for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and slideshow-style short-form content in English and German.
- Provides creative direction and sample structures for multiple content formats (video, slideshow, story, product demo, etc.).
- Outputs polished hooks, grouped by type, with guidance on slide/scene flow and A/B test sets.
- Rules for naturalness, platform style, and native tone, avoiding generic or overly "AI" phrasing.
- Includes both English and natural, spoken German hooks (no literal translation).
- Covers research-backed best practices for major short-form platforms.
summary: Create natural, high-retention hooks and opening text for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and slideshow/carousel-style short-form content in English...
